name: Molly menus
author: Brett
description: Molly's menus and skin without the UI: read the skin in force, every look choice (skin, day / night, density, text size, motion) with its current value, the menu tree with paths and live status sources, and the deep links that open Molly's skin picker, application menu, each sub-menu and any row's item settings; switch the skin, set any choice (Molly follows at once through its look document on axHub), run any menu item, and set or reset per-item behaviour and look overrides (control@1 tokens.menu). REST under /api/plugins/molly-menus, MCP tools molly-menus_*, CLI `axf molly-menus …`, AmberX voice.

items.title: Molly state
items.description: The skin in force, every look choice with its current value, live status (axHub, look document, skin) and the deep links.

items.title: Molly menu tree
items.description: Molly's application menu and context menus: each row's path, kind, action, shortcut, current value (choices), status source, sub-menu link and item-settings link.

items.title: Molly look choices
items.description: Skin, day / night, density, text size and motion: values offered, the current one, and a deep link per value.

items.title: Set a Molly look choice
items.description: Set skin, mode, density, text or motion; Molly applies it at once.

value.description: skin: molly-flagship | molly-flagship-night | own; mode: day | night; density: compact | standard | roomy; text: compact | molly-flagship | reader; motion: molly-flagship | minimal-motion

items.title: Molly skin
items.description: The skin in force in Molly (own = Molly's own look) and which level decided.

items.title: Switch Molly's skin
items.description: Use a skin in Molly (any skin or design package id), or own for Molly's own look.

skin.description: molly-flagship, molly-flagship-night, own, or any skin id

items.title: Run a Molly menu item
items.description: Run a row by its path (tree lists them): a choice is set here; anything else answers the deep link that runs it in Molly.

value.description: a choice's value (a two-way choice flips without one)

payload.description: the app id for context rows that act on one (amberx, axhub, console, expenses)

items.title: Molly deep links
items.description: Links that open Molly's skin picker, application menu, each sub-menu, any row's item settings, a choice, an action or an app.

items.title: Molly live status
items.description: axHub answering, Molly's look document on axHub, the skin in force: on / off / warn with a short text.

items.title: Molly menu item overrides
items.description: Every per-item behaviour and look override in force (control@1 tokens.menu).

items.title: Override a Molly menu item
items.description: Set one token of one menu row: label, icon, hint, action, shortcut, visible, order, tone, iconTone, weight, emphasis or size.

items.title: Reset Molly menu item overrides
items.description: Reset one token (path + token), every token of a row (path), or every override (neither). Needs the confirm token.
